name: ProteinGLUE
description: A multi-task benchmark suite of protein sequence prediction tasks to evaluate self-supervised protein representation models.
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (e.g., AUC, Pearson correlation, F1/accuracy depending on task)
general_score_metric: task-specific metrics / aggregated mean across tasks
reputation: Well-regarded within the protein representation learning community as a multi-task benchmark for self-supervised protein models.
notes: Multi-task suite with heterogeneous metrics per task; not an LLM benchmark. Potential contamination risk if upstream pretraining datasets overlap with evaluation sets; some tasks have limited test-set size.
